title: Watercolor 1337 Western Lake Drive
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Per WaterColor HOA, all guests 5 years of age or older must be included in your adult guest total in order to receive wristbands to access amenities and pools. This home is allotted 10 wristbands.- Located in the Camp District on Western Lake Drive- Fully equipped gourmet kitchen- Gas grill- 6-passenger Low-Speed Vehicle- 4 adult bikes- Parking for up to 3 vehicles- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, a second pool deck with additional lounge seating, a third pool with zero-entry, an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and a new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: This charming 3-bedroom coastal retreat comfortably sleeps 10 guests, making it ideal for families and large groups. Nestled in the heart of WaterColor, it comes with a low-speed vehicle (LSV), allowing family and friends to cruise over to the Airstreams of Seaside, the nearby Publix, the WaterColor beach access, and any of the community’s award-winning pools. Spend the morning at the WaterColor Beach Club and the afternoon lounging within the shade of an umbrella before the turquoise waters of the Gulf. This thoughtfully designed retreat is the consumate home base for an unforgettable family vacation!The front porch of this getaway could not be more inviting. Enjoy a morning coffee at the 6-person alfresco table or relax on the Adirondack chairs under the breeze of ceiling fans. French doors lead inside to a light-filled great room adorned with classic wainscoting and stunning hardwood floors—all set beneath a vaulted ceiling. A cozy living area features slip-covered sofas and nautical-striped armchairs arranged around a mounted TV and dual window seats. Adjacent is the gourmet kitchen with an open layout, polished countertops, and a 5-stool breakfast bar for entertaining. The dining table for 8 features woven chairs and pendant light, creating a laid-back atmosphere. The first level has 2 guest bedrooms, each with a king-sized bed and a private bathroom. Nearby is a spacious bunk room with 2 twin-over-full beds, providing versatility for families or larger groups.The second-level loft provides a secluded spot for relaxation or work. Challenge friends to a game of foosball—or check your emails at the desk. A plush twin daybed and twin trundle offer extra sleeping accommodations for families with children or last-minute guests.With its contemporary coastal design, cozy indoor and outdoor spaces, and proximity to extraordinary community amenities, 1337 Western Lake Drive has everything guests need for an unforgettable WaterColor getaway. Parking for 3 vehicles, a 6-passenger LSV, and 4 complimentary bikes make it easy to roam the local neighborhood—or go further afield toexplore the distinctive destinations of 30A. For beach access, visit the WaterColor Beach Club or use the access point beside the WaterColor Inn on Goldenrod Circle. Book today and start planning your 30A escape!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 12):FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom- Two Twin-over-Full Bunk beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Guest Loft- Twin Bed with Trundle, Private Bathroom with Shower onlyWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments, as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
